text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
...Shocking. You, failing. 
Given your caliber, assumed pass was guaranteed.

Failing Central License Exam came as shock... 
Yet failure had clear cause.
Showed Furioso brief breakdown of exam questions.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"Turf grass varieties." 
Required listing grass species used across Central tracks...?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Completely outside your scope. 
Funabashi—and almost all local venues—only run on dirt.

Not completely ignorant of subject, 
but pouring everything into Furioso's success meant 
ignoring topics irrelevant to her path.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
So many hyper-specific questions... Come to think of it, 
heard Central Exam is notoriously brutal for local transfers.
choice_data_list: To think it was like this……
To think it was like this……

text_block_list.text:
Many candidates sat alongside me... 
Only tiny fraction passed.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
What now...? Without license, 
Trainer cannot step foot in Tracen Academy...

Only one option left. 
Though puts burden on Furioso...
choice_data_list: For now……could you wait for me?
For now……could you wait for me?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Wait for you...?
choice_data_list: I'll pass the next exam for sure!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Until next exam...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
...Understood. I will handle solo training for now. 
We will make up lost ground once reunited.

Thus began period of independent work. 
One at Tracen Academy, other at Funabashi.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
(Ugh... recognise nobody around me... 
Presumably all top-tier elites...)

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
(Representing Funabashi means no backing down. 
Everyone here—is enemy.)

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hey hey, you're Furioso-san from Funabashi, right? 
I'm Smart Falcon☆!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Bit out of blue, but 
would you take one of these tickets?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Ticket? 
For what...?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Pass for my upcoming Idol Live concert! 
And during show, from crowd~

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"L-O-V-E! V-V-Falco♪" 
Could you chant along like that?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
(...Huh? What is this? 
Standard Central hazing ritual?)

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
(Makes no sense... Mocking me? 
Hidden angle...?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Oi. You the solo transfer 
from Funabashi? Tch... always brooding alone.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Show me what you got. 
We're running side-by-side intervals right now, get it?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
(Wait... checking in on me 
because I'm alone? ...No, impossible!)

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: —Declined.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Not participating. Simple exchange student, 
nothing more. ...Excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: The hell? Don't blow us off!

text_block_list.name: Falcon & Espoir
text_block_list.text:
Furioso-san♪ 
Hey, Furioso!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Ah, right...! 
Wait, no... ugh...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
(Closing distance constantly... Central is enemy turf. 
Yet talking with them reveals genuine goodwill...)

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
(At this rate, defenses will crumble... Keep talking, 
and friendship follows! Must stay loyal to hometown...)

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Will not... join you! 
I am not someone who mingles!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa... Once Trainer arrives...! 
All backlog training will be cleared in single push!

Days spent absorbed in intensive study. 
With question patterns mapped out, failure will not repeat.
choice_data_list: I'll pass for sure, next time!

text_block_list.text:
Tomorrow is the day I take the exam again.
I can't leave Furioso on her own like this any longer.

And so——the announcement of the results
of my second attempt at the License Exam.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Trai……ner……
Trai—……

The results were……a nightmare. For a while, neither
of us could say a single word. The only sound in the room
was the dripping of the kitchen faucet.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
So that's what happened…… The questions
were completely different from last time.

I was stunned when I saw the exam paper. As
expected of the Central Exams. My preparations
based on previous tests were thorough, but……

At this rate, there was no telling when I'd pass.
Her training was already falling behind, and our
goal of conquering Central was slipping away.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
We'll just have……to wait for next time.
Honestly, it's been hard on my own. But……

I couldn't help but feel bitter regret and guilt.
Yet there was something far more important than my own feelings——

We couldn't afford to waste any more time. Bringing out
Furioso's true potential……could easily be done by another trainer in Central.

Then——there was only one thing left for me to do.
For someone like me, there was only one choice——

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Eh, Trainer, what do you mean by stopping here……?
choice_data_list: I won't take the next exam

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
——?
Trai……ner……
The dripping of the faucet seemed to echo even louder.
